office: the Civil Registry and Migration Department, which issues every passport at its central offices in Nicosia
note: The fees are €70 for an adult and €45 for a minor under 18, as the High Commission in London lists them (it charges the equivalent in pounds, updated monthly). Sigmalive (31 July 2025) gives the expedited fees (the standard fee plus a €50 surcharge), the standard processing time of about 10 working days, which can grow with demand, and the validity of 10 years for adults and 5 for minors; it gives no time for the expedited route. A replacement for a lost, damaged or stolen passport costs double, which isn't modelled.

sources.title: High Commission of Cyprus in the UK, ID Card / Passport / Emergency Travel Document
sources.said: In case the applicant is a minor (under 18 years old): ... Fee Adults: The equivalent of €70.00 in £/GBP. Fee Minors (under 18 y/o): The equivalent of €45.00 in £/GBP for passport. Our price list is updated monthly depending on the current currency exchange.

sources.title: Sigmalive, All you need to know about last-minute ID or passport renewal? (31 July 2025)
sources.said: Fees Issuance/renewal of adult passport: €70 Issuance/renewal of minor’s passport: €45 Expedited issuance/renewal of adult passport: €120 (€70 fee + €50 surcharge) Expedited issuance/renewal of minor’s passport: €95 (€45 fee + €50 surcharge) ... All passports are issued at the central offices of the Civil Registry and Migration Department in Nicosia. ... The standard processing time is approximately 10 working days. ... Passports are valid for 10 years for adults and 5 years for minors.
